In our latest episode, we sat down with @simrun.chopra , one of India’s leading nutritionists with s community of over 8 lakh, for an honest conversation about women’s nutrition after 40.

We unpack:
→ How weight and metabolism change after 40
→ Why fibre becomes just as important as protein
→ What your post 40 grocery list should actually look like
→ A full day of eating for a perimenopausal woman

Consider this your 20 minute nutrition guide to help you know what to add & what to remove from your plate post 40.
